lines.text: Jesus sends the twelve to the lost sheep of Israel to preach that the kingdom of heaven is near.
Jesus tells the twelve to take no gold, silver, or copper, and no second tunic.
The twelve shake off the dust of unwelcoming towns, and Babylon and Nineveh will fare better.
Jesus sends the twelve out like sheep among wolves, and they will be flogged in their courtyards.
When the twelve are handed over, the Spirit of their Father will speak through them.
